Country singer John Rich joins Tucker Carlson for a talk that roams from show business to the end of days. The title names Diddy, demons, the Antichrist, and Rich's fight against child predators. It also names how Rich says he learned to hear God.

Rich speaks as a man of faith who sees a spiritual war behind the news. He talks about fame, evil in the music trade, and his work to guard kids. Carlson steers the talk toward prayer and what Rich hears from God. Listeners get a singer's raw take on fame and faith, with no filter in the way.
